plugins.name: tiktok-ai-plugin
plugins.description: Drive your own TikTok account from the terminal with your browser session (no TikTok API app, no Apify): sign in with cookies; read profiles, videos and comments; publish videos and photo posts from TikTok Studio's own web flow as approved dry runs; run content, audit and research workflows on real account data; break down any TikTok into shots and script; and get read-only monetization and ads advice (Creator Rewards eligibility, Studio analytics, kill/keep/scale from an Ads Manager export). Planned: travel drafts and a local ComfyUI remake.
